coverage_explanation: Tests all five independent sensor-to-LED mappings at ADC values 0, 499, 500, 501, and 1023, including strict threshold equality, mixed simultaneous states, repeated updates, and a final return to all-off. Also checks the explicitly required pin modes.
assumptions: The explicit raw-ADC rule governs: values strictly greater than 500 mean low brightness and turn the corresponding LED on; values at or below 500 turn it off.
The supplied circuit establishes active-HIGH LEDs on pins 2 through 6 and sensor inputs A0 through A4; no default LED or button wiring is needed.
Host analog inputs use the disclosed raw ADC0..1023 convention. Injected ADC values replace the circuit's initial lux settings; no lux conversion is performed.
No exact response period is specified. Each stimulus is held for 1000 ms and outputs are checked after 300 ms of settling.
Uno analog pins A0 through A4 are digital pin numbers 14 through 18 for pin-mode checks.
